subject.title: [Bug]: Subagent completion silently lost — no retry, no notification, no auto-restart on timeout

question: Should OpenClaw make subagent completion delivery durable and at-least-once, or keep best-effort announce with clearer failure visibility and narrower retry hardening?
rationale: The issue spans retry timing, duplicate-send prevention, task-ledger semantics, requester wakeup, and user-visible failure policy, so code inspection cannot choose the permanent delivery contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Design durable completion delivery
options.body: Make completion payloads durable with explicit delivered, failed, and recoverable states plus idempotent channel delivery before closing this issue.

options.title: Ship bounded visibility first
options.body: Accept a smaller retry and failure-notification mitigation while keeping the broader durability issue open.

options.title: Keep best-effort announce
options.body: Document best-effort announce as the intended contract and close only if maintainers decide durable completion delivery is out of scope.

recommendation.title: Design durable completion delivery
recommendation.body: Make completion payloads durable with explicit delivered, failed, and recoverable states plus idempotent channel delivery before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame and recent history put the active subagent delivery-state code under vincentkoc's recent changes, making him the best available routing owner from the evidence.
